# uptimekuma_monitor_radius (Resource)

Radius monitor resource for testing Radius server authentication. The monitor is up on an `Access-Accept` or, since Uptime Kuma 2.5.1, an `Access-Challenge` answer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Radius Monitor Resource Example

# Basic Radius monitor with minimum required configuration
resource "uptimekuma_monitor_radius" "basic" {
  name                       = "Radius Authentication Monitor"
  hostname                   = "radius.example.com"
  radius_username            = "monitor-user"
  radius_password            = "monitor-password"
  radius_secret              = "shared-secret"
  domain_expiry_notification = false
}

# Radius monitor with all available options
resource "uptimekuma_monitor_radius" "full" {
  name               = "Radius Authentication Monitor Full"
  description        = "Monitor Radius authentication server availability"
  hostname           = "radius.example.com"
  port               = 1812
  radius_username    = "monitor-user"
  radius_password    = "monitor-password"
  radius_secret      = "shared-secret"
  called_station_id  = "00-11-22-33-44-55"
  calling_station_id = "AA-BB-CC-DD-EE-FF"
  interval           = 120
  retry_interval     = 60
  max_retries        = 5
  active             = true
  upside_down        = false

  notification_ids = [1, 2]

  tags = [
    {
      tag_id = 1
      value  = "production"
    }
  ]
}

# Radius monitor on a non-default port (RADIUS accounting)
resource "uptimekuma_monitor_radius" "accounting" {
  name            = "Radius Accounting Monitor"
  hostname        = "radius.example.com"
  port            = 1813
  radius_username = "monitor-user"
  radius_password = "monitor-password"
  radius_secret   = "shared-secret"
  interval        = 300
}

# Requires Terraform or OpenTofu 1.11 or later: radius_password_wo and
# radius_secret_wo are never stored in plan or state. Change the matching
# *_wo_version whenever a secret changes.
resource "uptimekuma_monitor_radius" "write_only" {
  name = "RADIUS monitor with write-only credentials"

  hostname        = "radius.example.com"
  radius_username = "monitor"

  radius_password_wo         = "radius-password"
  radius_password_wo_version = "1"
  radius_secret_wo           = "radius-shared-secret"
  radius_secret_wo_version   = "1"
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `hostname` (String) Radius server hostname or IP address
- `name` (String) Friendly name
- `radius_username` (String) Username for Radius authentication

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `active` (Boolean) Monitor is active
- `called_station_id` (String) Optional Called-Station-Id attribute
- `calling_station_id` (String) Optional Calling-Station-Id attribute
- `description` (String) Description
- `domain_expiry_notification` (Boolean) Enable domain (WHOIS) expiry notification, independent of TLS certificate expiry notification (`expiry_notification`)
- `interval` (Number) Heartbeat interval in seconds. Minimum 20. Uptime Kuma 2.5.0 removed the former 24 day maximum, so no upper bound is enforced.
- `max_retries` (Number) Maximum number of retries
- `notification_ids` (List of Number) List of notification IDs
- `parent` (Number) Parent monitor ID for hierarchical organization
- `port` (Number) Radius server port
- `radius_password` (String, Sensitive) Password for Radius authentication Stored in state; use `radius_password_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `radius_password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Password for Radius authentication, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `radius_password`; requires `radius_password_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `radius_password_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `radius_password` until the next apply with `radius_password_wo` set removes it from state.
- `radius_password_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `radius_password_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `radius_password_wo`.
- `radius_secret` (String, Sensitive) Shared secret for the Radius server Stored in state; use `radius_secret_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `radius_secret_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Shared secret for the Radius server, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `radius_secret`; requires `radius_secret_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `radius_secret_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `radius_secret` until the next apply with `radius_secret_wo` set removes it from state.
- `radius_secret_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `radius_secret_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `radius_secret_wo`.
- `resend_interval` (Number) Resend interval in seconds
- `retry_interval` (Number) Retry interval in seconds. Minimum 20, and like `interval` it has no upper bound since Uptime Kuma 2.5.0.
- `tags` (Attributes Set) Set of tags assigned to this monitor (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `upside_down` (Boolean) Invert monitor status (treat DOWN as UP and vice versa)

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Monitor identifier

Required:

- `tag_id` (Number) Tag ID

Optional:

- `value` (String) Optional value for this tag
